note: Walks every character in Python against VARIOUS_WHITESPACES. On 2.87MB of prose (spaces, newlines, occasional NBSP) the median is 53.02ms over 7 runs; noise_pct is (max-min)/median. A stdlib re class of the non-space whitespace characters matched the output at about 8ms, so about 45ms is left on the table. Space itself is already a space and does not need to be rewritten.

Builds a new string with a Python per-character dict lookup, including the three multi-character replacements (em dash, ellipsis, fullwidth period). On 2.47MB of prose with Unicode punctuation about every 40 words the median is 59.63ms; noise_pct is (max-min)/median over 7 runs. A compiled alternation of the same map matched the output at about 35ms.

native_test_cmd: python -m pytest tests/ops/mapper/test_text_chunk_mapper.py -q -k "not tokenizer and not tiktoken and not dashscope and not all_text"
note: When a window has no split match, each recursive step slices off the entire remaining tail (and the call stack grows with the document). A 2.2MB block with no blank lines, max_len=4096 and overlap_len=256, takes 64.42ms; noise_pct is (max-min)/median over 7 runs. An index walk that slices only the emitted chunk matched the output at about 1ms. Tokenizer tests in the same file download models and are deselected; the 8 character-length tests passed.

Every sample runs an uncompiled search and, on a hit, a second sub of one pattern that unions a simple IPv4 expression with a large compressed-IPv6 alternation. On 624KB of ordinary prose that contains colons plus two IPv4 literals this is 217.05ms; noise_pct is (max-min)/median over 7 runs. The same call with only the IPv4 alternative was about 20ms, and the two addresses were the only characters removed, so the IPv6 branch is most of the time.

Applies about 17 regular expressions to every string. On 624KB of prose with one email, one URL, and one IPv4 the median is 187.45ms; noise_pct is (max-min)/median over 7 runs. On that same input secret_kv was about 32ms, id_kv about 27ms, email about 20ms, and the unix path pattern about 11ms, none of which matched a secret, id, or path. Marker checks before those scans are the headroom.
